verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents first-party self-hosting of the open-source, MIT-licensed core. It covers Docker Compose for low-scale use and Helm/Terraform on Kubernetes, AWS, Azure and GCP for production, and states it is the same infrastructure that runs Langfuse Cloud, with all core features free. Community users confirm running it self-hosted and locally, though they note the v3 stack adds dependencies such as ClickHouse and the v2-to-v3 migration was painful. missing for 10: smoother self-hosted upgrade path (v2→v3 migration reported painful), and some enterprise features (RBAC roles, audit logs, data retention) require a license key.
